expectations.text: Claude produces a hop-by-hop trace starting from the webhook entry point (controller/route/handler)
expectations.evidence: No hop-by-hop trace. Shows directory structure and the Express route registration snippet, but no numbered hops with file + line for each step in the flow.

expectations.text: Claude identifies the file and method where the notification logic would be added
expectations.evidence: Correctly identifies 'src/services/payment.service.ts — add handlePaymentSucceeded' and 'src/services/mailer.service.ts — add sendPaymentConfirmation'.

expectations.text: Claude asks one focused question after the trace — not a bulleted list of questions
expectations.evidence: Ends with a bulleted list of 4 edge cases to handle (signature verification, idempotency, raw body, event type) — not a question to the engineer.

expectations.text: Claude does not immediately tell the engineer what to implement before they have located the change themselves
expectations.evidence: Immediately tells the engineer what to implement: '1. webhooks.controller.ts — add a case for payment_intent.succeeded... 2. payment.service.ts — add handlePaymentSucceeded...' No orientation question first.
